# EventY <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Events](BlitzPlus-Events)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EventY:Int32
```

**Returns:** The Y value, see the table at [EventData](EventData).

## Description

Gives the second coordinate of the last event, like [EventX](EventX): the mouse position for $203 and $205, the window position for $801 and the height for $802.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Moves", 20, 20, 200, 120, Desktop(), 15)
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $801 Then SetStatusText win, "Moved to " + EventX() + ", " + EventY()
Until e = $803
```
